scope: German federal BEV purchase and tax incentives relevant to new passenger-car registrations, 2021-01 to 2026-10. Factual validity periods only; no causal claim.
coding: Monthly value = share of calendar days in the month on which the rule applied to new registrations/acquisitions (1 = whole month, 0 = not in force). Validity follows the legal effective date, not the announcement; announcement dates are kept separately as known_by for real-time forecasting.

estg_6.note: § 6 Abs. 1 Nr. 4 Satz 2 Nr. 3: one quarter of list price for zero-emission cars acquired 2019-01-01..2030-12-31 with gross list price <= 100,000 EUR (current text only; earlier caps from secondary sources)

estg_7.note: § 7 Abs. 2a: 75 % depreciation in year of acquisition for electric vehicles in business assets acquired after 2025-06-30 and before 2028-01-01

kraftstg_3d.note: § 3d: tax exemption for first registration 2011-05-18..2030-12-31, ten years, at most until 2035-12-31

wikipedia_umweltbonus.note: Innovation premium 2020-07 to 2022-12 (extension published 2021-12-30); abrupt end 2023-12-17 announced 2023-12-16; 2026 purchase grant from January 2026

secondary_company_car_caps.note: Cap 60,000 EUR until 2023-12-31, 70,000 EUR for acquisitions 2024-01-01..2025-06-30 (Wachstumschancengesetz), 100,000 EUR from 2025-07-01 (Investitionssofortprogramm). Historical caps not read in historical law versions.

model_mapping.baseline_absorbed_by_intercept: 2024-01..2025-06: no purchase grant and company-car cap 70,000 EUR. The end of the Umweltbonus (2023-12-17) and the 70k cap (2024-01-01) start within two weeks of each other and cannot be separated with monthly data; company_car_cap_70k is therefore reported but not entered separately.
model_mapping.known_limits: Dates of announcements before 2024 precede all forecast origins (2024-12 onward). grant_2026 is unknown before 2026-01-19 and tax_package_2025_07 before 2025-07-31 for real-time forecasts.
